summary: Paradise Craggy ground lookout, Siskiyou County: 1935 CCC-era station, 1969 CDF cab lost to lightning in 1989, present cab on the 732-GA plan; build date conflicts.

facts.design: ground cab based on the 732-GA plan; the only ground cab in the CDF&FP detection system

staffing.status: seasonal lookout in 1948; current staffing not found in the sources read

facts.agency: California Department of Forestry and Fire Protection, Siskiyou Unit (Cal Fire SKU)

events.note: Bulldozer left in the Yreka district for building the new road to the Paradise lookout
Telephone line ran to a new lookout house, per a Klamath National Forest chronology entry dated February 23, 1932; the entry also names Saturday, September 27th, so the year is uncertain
NHLR: original CCC-era lookout built for the USFS
Aircraft Warning Service used the lookout station as an observation post
Taken over by CDF (NHLR); Mrs. E. E. Boehm's Yreka-based lookout season was reported by a Dunsmuir paper in November 1948
ECW structure (the register's term) replaced by a CDF-designed cab, Plan Number 284
The Plan Number 284 cab was destroyed by lightning
Registered on the National Historic Lookout Register

resolved_conflicts.explanation: NHLR dates the original CCC-era lookout to 1935. The Forest Lookouts page has a 1931 road to the Paradise lookout and a chronology entry dated February 1932 about a new lookout house. The story gives both and does not choose one.

notes_for_editor: Current staffing and public access are not established; the brief lists access as unknown and the NHLR page does not address it. The NHLR says Location: Siskiyou National Forest, while the Forest Lookouts page files the lookout under Siskiyou County and CDF; the story uses the NHLR's administrator. The 1932 chronology entry is internally inconsistent: it is dated February 23, 1932 but refers to a Saturday, September 27th; the story now flags that the year is uncertain. The NHLR page does not expand 'ECW', so the story keeps the abbreviation. The brief's event list has no construction event; the 1935 build and the 1932 house are added. A search snippet for an ALERTCalifornia Facebook post says the lookout was built in 1935 and that ALERTCalifornia installed cameras there in 2023; Facebook returned only the post title on fetch, so it is not cited. A reviewer who can open it could confirm current use. The Forest Lookouts page also lists a 1934 panorama photo session and a 1948 season; not used beyond the events. No photos added. The brief's kind (ground), status (standing) and NHLR registration (October 27, 2019) match the sources; no corrections proposed.
